# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

WITJAI CHICHÁGKAGTIN UK YA BAISH-KAM, AME SENCHIJUM SUGUSBAWA DUWI YABAIK AGKAN PUJAJAL. TIKICHIC AMEA IBAUK ATSAWAI, ISHA-MANIMVAIJATMAINIK, AMEKETIME PUUJT SUKAGTINMEK.
